lines.before: **The A/B/C shape:** context (problem, what is locked, what is at stake) -> options with pros / cons -> security / design impact -> honest recommendation -> stop. Cover the whole space, extensive and rule-bending options included, each labelled by effort (Small / Moderate / EXTENSIVE) and rules (OK / BENDS <the lock> / BREAKS Tier 0), with whether pros beat cons for extensive or bending ones; the impossible marked so, with proof; a rule-breaking option is for contrast, never recommended. Why: a partial list hides the option the owner would pick.
